messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — NebulaCloud asked to onboard their z1-edge region into our marketplace next month. They want a dedicated quota and KMS integration for customer keys. Can we get an ops + legal check on feasibility?

Lina: tagging eng-sre: we need to validate capacity. Do we have spare Dedicated pools near z1? @Jordan any rough numbers? :thinking_face: 

Jordan: I checked yesterday — west-eu spare GPUs are limited but we can carve out 4 x A10g for initial pool. Throughput will be ~120 qps with current batching. We'll need quota increase in their marketplace listing though.

Sam: OK — initial ask from Nebula is 6 machines, can we do 4 for go-live and scale after?

Jordan: 4 is safe short-term. If legal/KMS requires HSM-backed keys we need to involve infra for key wrapping.

Priya: Legal here — will need partner agreement addendum for marketplace listing + data residency notes. Also flag: KMS integration requires an executed DPA addendum if partner manages keys. Can we get the exact KMS flow they want?

Ash: I'm on the Nebula side. They want customer-managed keys via our KMS proxy (customer supplies wrapped key to Nebula). They asked for an audit trail and a go/no-go by EOD Friday so marketing can schedule joint announcement.

Sam: Noted. Lina — can eng-sre support the KMS proxy path? We have a small existing workflow: customers can register external keys via our KMS proxy token exchange. If Nebula requires HSM attestation we may need a config change.

Lina: We support the proxy flow today but attestation/HSM metadata isn't surfaced to partners. Exposing that will be a 2-week change. For now we can offer "redwood-managed-key with audit logs" as a fallback.

Jordan: Also FYI: marketplace quota increases need a marketplace ticket + partner entitlement. I can open the ticket but we need the exact SKU and requested capacity. Ash — can you confirm SKU id from Nebula?

Ash: Nebula sent SKU: NBZ1-EDGE-XL and requested 6 units. They're flexible to start with 4. I'll push for 4 now and note burst options.

Sam: Great. Next steps: 1) Ash to confirm SKU and push Nebula to accept 4 for launch (owner: Ash). 2) Jordan to open marketplace quota ticket with SKU + requested units (owner: Jordan). 3) Priya to draft addendum and confirm DPA/KMS implications (owner: Priya). 4) Lina to confirm technical fallback (redwood-managed-key) and timeline for HSM attestation surfacing (owner: Lina).

Priya: I'll draft the addendum today and share a short checklist for compliance. If they insist on customer HSM keys we need their SOC report.

deploy-bot: Created ticket #PLT-8821 for marketplace entitlement request (assigned to Jordan).

Jordan: Ticket created and submitted to marketplace team. ETA for quota approval typically 3-5 business days. I added the throughput estimate and requested a soft-commit for 4 units.

Ash: Confirmed to Nebula that we'll aim for 4 units at launch and that KMS will be redwood-managed by default; they asked for the DPA draft before signing.

Sam: Good. Marketing timeline — can we aim for a joint blog two weeks after quota is approved? That gives time for testing. @Priya will that be okay with addendum turnaround?

Priya: Two weeks post-approval is tight but doable if Nebula signs quickly. I'll prioritize the addendum and include the DPA clause.

Lina: On infra: schedule-wise, if quota approved by Tue we can have pools provisioned and smoke tests done within 4 business days. HSM metadata surfacing still 2 weeks, so fallback remains.

Sam: Perfect. I'll summarize and send to Nebula. Also: can someone add a short runbook for onboarding z1-edge customers (KMS steps, contact list)? We should have it before the announcement.

Jordan: I'll add a basic runbook in GH and link to the ticket.

Ash: Thanks team — I'll keep Nebula updated and push for signatures. Will ping here if they push for HSM earlier. :thumbsup:

partners-bot: Reminder — product marketing calendar updated: potential co-announcement slot on 2026-05-18 if approvals complete by 2026-05-04.

Sam: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. I'll post a short summary for Nebula after lunch.

Lina: small note — test credentials will need to be isolated to partner sandbox; I'll send the sandbox CIDR and onboarding checklist tomorrow.

Priya: Uploaded preliminary addendum draft to /legal/drafts/nebula_z1 (internal). Will share link once redlines are in.

Jordan: Update: marketplace approved soft-commit for 4 units, final approval pending contract. Ticket #PLT-8821 -> status: soft-committed. (1777777833)
